title: MXT case catalog
description: The list of cases that SHOULD exist, kept in the application repo and synced to the platform via POST /api/v1/apps/:app/catalog:sync. See specs/03-case-catalog.md. schemaVersion 1 catalogs (compass) are accepted; missing fields take defaults.

surface.description: Default surface for cases in this file. Decides whether runs go to the server runner pool or to a local machine.

executionMode.description: Free-text, informational. Kept for schemaVersion 1 compatibility.

id.description: <APP>-<SURFACE>-<DOMAIN>-<NNN>. Unique per app, not globally — compass keeps its existing LP-FE-* ids. Never reuse a retired id.

tracks.description: Which tracks this case participates in. Membership lives here, not in the spec's directory — that is what lets one spec serve both the functional and the review/demo track.

requirementRef.description: Requirement or story id. Without it, requirement coverage cannot be computed and must not be claimed.

retired.description: Soft delete. Keeps historical runs resolvable; the id stays reserved.
